

# replace.exe is all Rust (replace-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/replace-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# replace.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/replace-rust/src/replace/replace.rs)
# util.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/replace-rust/src/replace/util.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(replace_shims OBJECT rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_compile_definitions(replace_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(replace_res OBJECT replace.rc)
target_compile_definitions(replace_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(replace_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(REPLACE_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils.a
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/conutils/libconutils_rust.a)
add_cargo_module(replace replace-cargo replace.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE replace-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS replace_shims replace_res ${REPLACE_REUSED})
